prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-realistic close-up image of a human hand gently holding a perfectly spherical, translucent orb of golden amber. Suspended in the center of the amber sphere is a detailed, lifelike mosquito, its delicate wings and slender legs clearly visible, as if frozen in time. The amber glows with rich hues of gold, orange, and honey, casting warm, luminous reflections and subtle shadows on the hand beneath. The background is softly blurred, creating a shallow depth of field that draws all attention to the orb and its ancient insect prisoner. The lighting is dramatic yet natural, highlighting the textures of both the amber and the skin, and giving the scene a cinematic, almost magical quality. The overall mood is one of wonder and curiosity, evoking themes of preservation, time, and the mysteries of nature.
